summary: Practise HR risk checks, case documentation and compliance reporting in five days. Review the outline and see what you will take back to work.
lede: HR compliance training helps HR officers, employee-relations specialists and HR managers apply consistent controls to employment decisions. Participants practise mapping HR risks, checking recruitment and employee-file records, and documenting workplace concerns, grievances and corrective actions. The course uses ISO 37301:2021 and the ILO Declaration on Fundamental Principles and Rights at Work as reference points for this work.
audienceIntro: This foundation course is designed for professionals who make, review or document employment decisions and need consistent HR compliance controls. It suits people who work with recruitment, employee relations, records, conduct concerns or management reporting.
modules: Code of Conduct and HR Conflicts
HR Compliance Reporting and Action Plans
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with HR records or employee lifecycle processes is useful. No legal qualification or programming experience is assumed.
